title: Graduate Programs
text:
S. No. | Subjects
01 | B.Ed. (1.5 Years) Eligibility: MA/MSc with at least 2nd division (45% marks).
02 | M.Sc. Biochemistry Eligibility: B.Sc., Biochemistry/Chemistry with any other subject of life sciences. with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
03 | M.Sc. Botany Eligibility: B.Sc. (with Botany) with at least 2nd Division (45% Marks).
04 | M.Sc. Chemistry Eligibility: B.Sc. (with Chemistry) with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
05 | M.Sc. Economics Eligibility: B.Sc./BA (Economics preferred subject)/B.Com. with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
06 | M.Sc. Mathematics Eligibility: B.Sc. (with Maths A & Maths B) with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
07 | M.Sc. Physics Eligibility: B.Sc. (with Physics & Mathematics) with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
08 | M.Sc. Zoology Eligibility: B.Sc. (with Zoology) with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
09 | MA Art & Design Eligibility: BA/B.Sc. At least 2nd division (45% marks).
10 | MA English Eligibility: B.A. (with English Elective) at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
11 | MA International Relation (IR) Eligibility: B.Sc./BA (Political Science preferred subject) with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
12 | MA Islamic Studies Eligibility: BA (Islamic Studies preferred subject) or equivalent, with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
13 | MA Journalism & Mass Communication Eligibility: B.Sc./BA with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
14 | MA Pakistan Studies Eligibility: B.Sc./BA with at least 2nd division (45% marks).
15 | MA Pashto Eligibility: B.Sc./BA with at least 2nd division (45% marks).
16 | MA Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) Eligibility: B.Sc./BA with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
17 | MA Political Science Eligibility: B.Sc./BA (Political Science preferred subject) with at least 2nd division (45% marks).
18 | MA Psychology Eligibility: B.Sc./BA with Psychology/ Applied Psychology/ Sociology/ Education/ Statistics/ Social Work with at least 2nd division (45% Marks) or B.Sc. in Behavioral Sciences/Home Economics with at least 2nd division (45% Marks) or B.Sc. (Hons) Psychology (03 years) with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
19 | MA Sociology Eligibility: B.Sc./BA (Sociology Preferred) at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
20 | M.Sc. Statistics Eligibility: B.Sc./BA with at least 2nd division (45% Marks).
21 | MA Tourism & Hospitality Eligibilit y: B.Sc./BA with at least 2nd division (45% marks).
22 | Master in Computer Science (MCS) Eligibility: B.Sc. (Computer Science)/B.Sc. (Maths A & Maths B, Computer Science)/B.Sc. (Maths A, Physics, Computer Science)/B.Sc. (Maths A, Statistics, Computer Science) with at least 2nd division (45% marks).
